fieldNotes.truckGate: Street View (2022-01) shows a chain-link sliding gate across the truck driveway off the cul-de-sac on the building's east side.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small single-room guard booth with windows sits on the right side of the gate lane, beside the sliding gate.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock bank on the east face with levelers, confirmed in Street View; LoopNet spec sheet for Stockton Commerce Center lists 64 dock doors.
fieldNotes.railServed: Stockton Commerce Center spec sheet lists 5 rail-served receiving doors; rail spur serves the building.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Striped trailer-parking lanes in the truck court east of the building hold drop trailers.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from perimeter box around the PFG-occupied building and its east truck court.
